description: The new PROP-BILL-062 and PROP-BILL-063 (orchestration ordering) were added to address FIND-009 (HIGH). PROP-BILL-062 (line 141) asserts 7 ordering invariants for the subscribe flow and PROP-BILL-063 (line 142) asserts 4 for cancel. However, the traceability matrix for REQ-BILL-011 (line 262) still only lists PROP-BILL-031 as the sole PROP obligation. PROP-BILL-062 references REQ-BILL-011 in its REQ column, but the traceability matrix row for REQ-BILL-011 does not include PROP-BILL-062. Same for REQ-BILL-021 (line 272) which only lists PROP-BILL-046 but not PROP-BILL-063. Traceability matrix inconsistency means an auditor checking the matrix alone would miss these critical orchestration PROPs.
